KIDDO.SCHOOL

Privacy, in plain language.

This pilot keeps things simple.

Last updated: 4 October 2026.

No accounts or submissions

This website has no sign-up, comments, upload forms, mailing list or database. It does not ask children to send names, photographs or completed worksheets.

Search stays in your browser

Search and filters run in your browser. The search text and selected filters may appear in the page URL so you can bookmark a search. A hosting provider may see that URL when the page is loaded, so do not enter personal or sensitive information in search.

No site analytics or advertising scripts

This pilot does not set application cookies, use browser storage, or include third-party analytics, advertising, tracking pixels or externally hosted fonts. Material checkboxes reset when you leave or reload the page. Handwriting, plant-activity drawings and typed answers stay in temporary browser memory, are never uploaded, and disappear when you refresh or close the page. The Save button creates an image on your device.

Hosting and downloads

A hosting provider may process ordinary technical information, such as IP addresses and request logs, to serve and protect the website. Downloaded sheets stay on your device; the website does not receive what you write or draw on them.

Future changes

If forms, analytics, advertising or other services are added, this page should be updated before those features are enabled.
